newsitem.title: UK: Aeroflot adds cargo capacity to UK market.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot adds cargo capacity to UK market.

text.p: Aeroflot Russian International Airlines is adding extra cargo capacity to the UK market with the introduction of a weekly 10,000kg-capacity 767 service from Heathrow to Moscow on Fridays.

This will brings to 13 the number of exHeathrow Aeroflot flights per week the others being operated by A3l0 and IL86 aircraft with 4000kg capacity, Aeroflot UK cargo sales agent Air Marketing Associates (AMA) said.

Aeroflot's summer schedule which starts on April 1 includes four flights per week to St. Petersburg (three from London Gatwick, and one from London Heathrow). Tokyo will gain an extra flight per week via Moscow from Heathrow, bringing total flights to Japan to three per week.

AMA said it is adding to Aeroflot's ex-UK cargo capacity to Moscow, Japan and Korea by marketing Aeroflot DC10 freighter services from Frankfurt with a dedicated five day a week road feeder services. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
